name: Izabela Hamilton
title: Communications specialist and executive coach
profile: Izabela is a communications specialist and ICF certified executive coach with more than 20 years' international experience across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. She led public relations for Jumeirah Group's flagship Burj Al Arab hotel and has trained and coached professionals for central banks, UN organisations and Fortune 500 companies across EMEA. She has taught at Middlesex University and coaches in English and Polish.
